analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,277,000 KRW) above SMA5 (1,258,800 KRW), below SMA20 (1,557,850 KRW) and SMA50 (1,633,569 KRW): indicating a short-term rebound attempt within a weak medium-term trend.
· Below SMA100 (1,878,804 KRW) and SMA200 (1,473,403 KRW): confirming a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position at 32.1% + current price level is high relative to the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (26.0→33.4): attempting to exit oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-62226.8981→-37342.7945): improving, but weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 1,066,537 KRW) + band width at a wide 63.08% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 1,246,000 KRW: higher than the 5-day low of 1,171,000 KRW.
· Swing resistance at 1,890,000 KRW: lower than the 52-week high of 2,987,000 KRW.
· 5-day high/low at 1,329,000 KRW / 1,171,000 KRW, 20-day high/low at 1,935,000 KRW / 1,171,000 KRW: sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio at 1.05: normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosed as accumulation: consider buying upon confirmation of support at 1,246,000 KRW.
